question: What power to shake the three worlds comes from contemplating a smoky form?
premises: A smoky-colored form is to be contemplated
The contemplation is to be done always
The triple world can be shaken as a result
inference: By always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object contemplated as smoke-colored is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
